title: CHRISTIAN COUNSELLING
modules: Focusing On The Problem Of Self Reliance……… 60
mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ are considered as targets that the sermon must "hit".
People (the church members ) are considered as targets that the sermon must "hit".
Fill in the blank: ______ is an individual personality that needs to be allowed to be independent and nurtured to grow at his own pace.
The counselee is an individual personality that needs to be allowed to be independent and nurtured to grow at his own pace.
Fill in the blank: ______ is made up of two Greek words: "psyche' meaning "soul" or "mind" and "logos" meaning "study of".
Psychology is made up of two Greek words: "psyche' meaning "soul" or "mind" and "logos" meaning "study of".
Fill in the blank: ______ is an old fashioned quality, but it is still priceless and effective in our modern society.
Goodness is an old fashioned quality, but it is still priceless and effective in our modern society.
fib: ______ is a particular time of stress, and endocrine disturbances occur frequently in the 9 -13years age group.
Puberty is a particular time of stress, and endocrine disturbances occur frequently in the 9 -13years age group.
______ is an outlet for human expression, although some talk seems to have little or no significance, it is usually more than just a succession of words.
Language is an outlet for human expression, although some talk seems to have little or no significance, it is usually more than just a succession of words.
______ is a whole being, that whatsoever affects one portion usually affects the entire human organism.
Counsellors should understand that man is a whole being, that whatsoever affects one portion usually affects the entire human organism.

Pulpit preaching is a blessing, but it may not always meet the specific needs of the individual church members.
